repaired_diagnostic_failures.reason: Native score above the exact maximum violates the nonpositive input domain of the validated exp2 table. The raw stdout contains nan and is retained as text; PowerShell JSON parsing rejected it even though the native process exited zero.

Capping native scores at the exact maximum leaves an underestimated maximum score below its canonical value. A single-token probability and denominator can then be below 1, outside the validated reciprocal domain. The new finite-output assertion stopped at the first 32 queries with native exit2.

hybrid_definition: Use exact QK prefix maxima and alpha values. Keep scores attaining that maximum exact, cap other native overestimates at it, and compute remaining probabilities from native scores. The probability-only output uses the canonical denominator; denominator-only uses the canonical PV accumulator and hybrid denominator. Native-alpha-only uses canonical BF16 probabilities and denominator.

rounding_document_review.title: RDNA3 Instruction Set Architecture Reference Guide
rounding_document_review.observation: AMD specifies round-to-nearest-even as the only floating WMMA rounding mode. The general FP_ROUND register offers four modes, but the WMMA-specific restriction prevents treating that general setting as a supported RTZ WMMA switch.
rounding_document_review.action: No runtime rounding-mode changes or unsupported WMMA setting introduced. Return to numerical decomposition and exact replay design.
rounding_document_review.scope: Official architecture documentation, not a new native arithmetic or product measurement.

decision: Investigate selective score repair with independently checked bounds: refine possible prefix maxima and BF16 probability boundaries, then retain a separate denominator/output fallback. Centering and maximum anchors reduce probability differences but do not make native QK canonical. A denominator-only substitution still changes1853 BF16 outputs across1809 heads. No runtime option is enabled by this diagnostic.
limitations: The complete exact QK scores construct these hybrids. This is a numerical decomposition, not an implementation that avoids exact score work.
External GB10 BF16 context is comparison-only; the canonical variant matches all29364224 cells. No model is loaded and no generated tokens or real callback TTFT are measured.
Whole-allocation redzones and input immutability pass. Scratch buffers are reused; this does not establish per-slab tail redzones.
Maximum native score error and hybrid denominator error are observations on this capture, not general error bounds or calibration constants.
The AMD ISA documentation is a supported-operation constraint, not a native experiment changing GPU rounding registers.
The qualified direct-PV product stack remains unchanged at46055.3727ms q8192 callback TTFT. Retained performance, long-context, package, HTTP, soak and release gates remain open.
